_readme: Special badges the Hermit can give out (Hermit menu > Rewards). To add one: put a square PNG (128x128, transparent background) in images/badges/, add a line here, push. The id must be unique and never change (players keep it). Shown next to player names when they pick it.

badges.description: Won the Plunge game on stream (2026-09-30).
